name: Tice's Corner Marketplace
summary: Tice's Corner Marketplace is an upscale lifestyle center in Woodcliff Lake featuring 22 distinctive specialty retailers including Anthropologie, Apple, Pottery Barn, and J. Crew. The open-air shopping destination offers a sophisticated blend of fashion, home furnishings, technology, and dining that caters to discerning shoppers seeking premium brands in an elegant setting.
demographics: Tice's Corner Marketplace attracts affluent shoppers from the Bergen County area, particularly families and professionals with above-average household incomes drawn to the upscale retail mix. The primary trade area includes Woodcliff Lake and surrounding communities like Saddle River, Park Ridge, and Hillsdale, known for their high-income demographics and educated populations. Typical visitors are style-conscious consumers aged 30-65 who appreciate premium brands and specialty retailers, with a strong preference for curated shopping experiences over traditional mall environments. The center caters to discerning shoppers seeking quality home furnishings, contemporary fashion, and lifestyle products in an open-air setting.
description: Tice's Corner Marketplace is a distinctive lifestyle shopping destination located in Woodcliff Lake, New Jersey, offering a carefully curated collection of twenty-two specialty retailers. The center caters to discerning shoppers with an impressive lineup of premium brands including Anthropologie, Apple, Pottery Barn, J. Crew, Williams-Sonoma, and Free People, creating a unique blend of fashion, home furnishings, technology, and dining options. The open-air shopping environment provides a sophisticated alternative to traditional enclosed malls, featuring upscale tenants like Bluemercury, Ethan Allen, Madewell, and White House | Black Market alongside popular lifestyle brands such as Athleta, Banana Republic, and Nike. Dining options include Bareburger and Panera, while wellness and personal care services are represented by JETSET Pilates, The Parlour, and James Tracey Eye Care. With its focus on quality over quantity and its appeal to style-conscious consumers, Tice's Corner has established itself as a premier shopping destination in Bergen County, offering shoppers the convenience of experiencing the best brands all in one place with an emphasis on ease and sophistication.
